amendments.reason: The Trade Marks Office Manual of Practice and Procedure has been updated. The chapter Examination of Trade Marks for Plants (in class 31) has been revised and renamed Part 32A – Examination of trade mark applications relating to plants or plant materials. See the official notice on the IP Australia website for details.

The Trade Marks Office Manual of Practice and Procedure has been updated. The chapter Examination of Trade Marks for Plants (in class 31) has been revised and renamed Part 32A – Examination of trade mark applications relating to plants or plant materials. See the official notice on the IP Australia website for details.
